controlifychords.binding.open_config.des: Bind any controller button to this in Controlify; pressing it opens the chord config.
controlifychords.config.title: Controlify Chords
controlifychords.config.debug.tip: Log chord state changes and skip reasons.
controlifychords.config.help: Fill both pools on the General page first, then pick from the dropdowns on each chord page. Hold all modifiers and tap any trigger.
controlifychords.config.chord.new.tip: Fill this page and save to append a new chord. Leave it empty to add nothing. No limit on the number of chords.
controlifychords.config.name: Display name
controlifychords.config.action_value.tip: KEY_MAPPING: a key name such as key.swapOffhand. COMMAND: e.g. /spawn. CUSTOM: a registered action id.
controlifychords.config.delete.tip: Enable and save to delete this chord.
controlifychords.capture.title: Capture button
controlifychords.capture.prompt.modifier: Press the button you want to use as a MODIFIER
controlifychords.capture.prompt.trigger: Press the button you want to use as a TRIGGER
controlifychords.capture.hint: It returns and writes the list automatically; Esc to cancel
controlifychords.config.pool.modifier.de: Modifier pool: buttons allowed as held modifiers. Chord modifier dropdowns only list these.
controlifychords.config.pool.trigger.des: Trigger pool: buttons allowed as tapped triggers. Chord trigger dropdowns only list these.
controlifychords.config.pool.tip: Use controlify:button/xxx, or press the capture button below and press a controller button.
controlifychords.capture.pool.modifier: Capture button → add to modifier pool
controlifychords.capture.pool.trigger: Capture button → add to trigger pool
